project.name: SkillForge
project.summary: A mobile-first, multi-tenant AI-powered Learning Operating System for tuition centres and coaching institutes.

vision: Make the complete class lifecycle operationally simple while turning every lesson artifact into structured, teacher-governed learning evidence that improves decisions for institutions, teachers, students, and parents.
coreJourney: An organization owner configures branches, subjects, syllabuses, users, classes, and timetables.
A teacher opens the next class workflow and starts the lesson session.
The teacher marks attendance and uploads the transcript, resources, student notes, and assigned work.
SkillForge organizes the class artifacts as structured learning evidence and updates the Learning Graph.
AI analyzes evidence, compares notes and objectives, detects possible learning gaps, and drafts progress findings.
The teacher reviews, edits, approves, or rejects every academic recommendation before publication.
Approved outcomes become visible through role-appropriate organization, teacher, student, and parent dashboards.

goals.statement: Center daily product use on a guided end-to-end class lifecycle rather than disconnected menus.
Build a continuously evolving Learning Graph from complete student learning evidence rather than isolated grades.
Use AI to assist teachers while keeping teachers the final authority over all published academic decisions.
Support secure multi-tenant organizations with multiple branches, subjects, and role-specific operations.
Make the next required action immediately clear on mobile and desktop for every role.
Support a commercial model based on active students.

requirements.statement: Provide authentication for Platform Owner, Organization Owner, Branch Manager, Teacher, Student, and Parent roles.
Enforce strong role-based permissions, tenant isolation, branch scoping, and auditable privileged actions at trusted boundaries.
Manage organizations, branches, role assignments, students, teachers, parents, and their permitted relationships.
Manage syllabus libraries, custom syllabuses, subjects, classes, and timetables across branches.
Guide teachers through Start Class, Mark Attendance, Upload Transcript, Upload Resources, Assign Homework, Review AI, and Publish Class.
Record attendance, lesson sessions, assignments, homework, worksheets, quizzes, exams, teacher observations, and file uploads.
Ingest lesson transcripts and student notes with visible processing, failure, retry, and recovery states.
Normalize learning evidence and connect it to students, lessons, syllabus objectives, subjects, classes, branches, and organizations.
Maintain a Learning Graph that traces progress and gaps back to source evidence.
Analyze transcripts, compare notes, detect potential learning gaps, and draft progress summaries during AI roadmap phase 1.
Require explicit teacher review and approval before AI-derived academic findings or progress updates are published.
Provide an organization dashboard for institutional analytics, branch management, teacher oversight, curriculum progress, billing, and permissions.
Provide a teacher dashboard for daily work, student management, attendance, uploads, assignments, AI review, and approvals.
Provide a student dashboard for lessons, homework, notes, feedback, and approved progress.
Provide a parent dashboard for approved progress summaries, homework, attendance, teacher updates, and suggested support.
Allow authorized organization users to manually activate or deactivate billable students, preserve an audit trail, and generate immutable monthly usage snapshots for plan and invoice tracking.
Use modular domain boundaries and an extensible AI pipeline so roadmap modules can be added without major rewrites.
Provide a mobile-first, responsive, accessible interface with clear next actions and usable failure recovery.
Version database schema, tenant policies, storage rules, background processing, and configuration in the repository.
Deploy one canonical production identity at https://skillforge-bay-three.vercel.app when the release gate passes.

Support India-first student-data governance through versioned, organization-configurable consent and retention policies within platform limits, plus export, deletion, residency, and policy controls adaptable to later regions.
Use one Supabase backend with versioned Postgres migrations, RLS, storage policies, authentication integration, and tenant-aware server boundaries.

Let each organization configure its own supported AI provider through tenant-scoped server-side credentials and a provider interface with validation, observability, retries, and safe failure handling.

nonGoals.statement: SkillForge will not behave primarily as a traditional course-content LMS.
AI will not automatically publish grades, progress judgements, learning gaps, or other academic decisions.
AI worksheet, lesson-plan, quiz, and homework generation are outside the phase-1 MVP.
The personalized AI tutor, adaptive revision, and long-term learning companion are outside the phase-1 MVP.
The MVP will not create duplicate production projects or production aliases for testing.
Live subscription payment collection and payment-processor integration are outside the current MVP.

constraints.statement: All organization-scoped data and actions must be isolated by tenant and, where applicable, branch.
The product must be mobile-first and keep the next action obvious for every role.
Teachers remain the final authority for academic publication and progress approval.
The architecture must use modular feature boundaries, domain-driven organization, strong RBAC, audit logging, and an extensible AI pipeline.
Secrets and privileged credentials must remain outside source code, logs, chat, and evidence.
Production uses exactly one Vercel project and the canonical URL https://skillforge-bay-three.vercel.app.
Student-data controls must launch India first while keeping consent, retention, export, deletion, residency, and policy behavior configurable for later regions.
Use exactly one new Supabase project for the product after charter approval, organization selection, and explicit cost confirmation.
Closed billing-period usage snapshots are immutable; later activation changes affect only open or future periods unless an authorized adjustment is recorded.
Organization-supplied AI credentials remain tenant-scoped, encrypted or provider-secret-managed, server-only, and absent from browser payloads, logs, and evidence.

productPrinciples: Organize the experience around workflows, not menus.
Show every user what they need to do next.
Treat complete learning evidence as the primary source of truth.
Preserve traceability from progress claims back to source evidence.
AI recommends; teachers decide and publish.
Design for mobile use during real classes.
Prefer extensible modules over speculative rewrites.

successCriteria.statement: A teacher can complete the full guided class lifecycle from Start Class through Publish Class without leaving the workflow.
successCriteria.verificationMethod: Automated browser journey plus explicit owner acceptance
requiredEvidence: Browser recording bound to the exact preview commit

successCriteria.statement: No role can read or mutate another tenant's protected data, and branch-scoped roles cannot escape permitted branches.
successCriteria.verificationMethod: Database policy, API authorization, and adversarial integration tests

successCriteria.statement: Learning evidence from transcripts, notes, attendance, work, observations, and syllabus objectives can be traced into the Learning Graph and back to its source.
Organization-supplied AI processing remains tenant-isolated, produces drafts only, and cannot publish an academic decision without an authorized teacher approval action.
Organization, teacher, student, and parent dashboards expose only role-appropriate information and make the next action immediately understandable.
successCriteria.verificationMethod: Role-specific browser journeys and human acceptance

successCriteria.statement: Multi-branch, multi-subject organizations can configure syllabuses, classes, timetables, users, and assignments without cross-branch leakage.
successCriteria.verificationMethod: Integration tests and admin browser journey

successCriteria.statement: Attendance, transcript ingestion, uploads, and AI processing provide usable loading, empty, invalid, failure, retry, and recovery states.
successCriteria.verificationMethod: Browser, upload, queue, and failure-injection tests

successCriteria.statement: Authorized manual student activation produces reproducible immutable monthly usage snapshots, plans, and invoices with auditable adjustments and no cross-tenant visibility.
requiredEvidence: Authorized plan and invoice browser journey

successCriteria.statement: The application passes relevant static analysis, automated tests, production build, accessibility checks, and representative small-screen journeys from a clean setup.
successCriteria.verificationMethod: Clean install, CI, build, accessibility, and responsive browser verification

successCriteria.statement: The canonical production URL serves the exact accepted commit after preview verification and has a documented rollback path.
requiredEvidence: Production deployment ID and commit SHA

successCriteria.statement: Student-data consent, organization-configurable retention within approved platform limits, export, deletion, residency, and audit controls implement the India-first global-ready policy.
successCriteria.verificationMethod: Policy review, permission tests, and lifecycle tests

officialFacts.statement: The primary market is tuition centres and coaching institutes.
SkillForge is an AI-powered Learning Operating System, not a traditional LMS.
The product is multi-tenant, multi-branch, multi-subject, mobile-first, and priced per active student.
Teachers always retain final authority over academic publication.
The class lifecycle and complete learning evidence are the central operating model.
The required production URL is https://skillforge-bay-three.vercel.app.
Student-data governance launches India first with global-ready configurable controls.
